inverse-functions-reflect.alt: Graph of f(x) = x squared over 4 for x at least 0 and its inverse 2 times the square root of x, mirror images across the dashed line y = x; (2, 1) on f matches (1, 2) on the inverse.

inverse-functions-restrict.alt: The parabola y = (x - 2) squared + 1. Its left half, for x less than 2, is dashed gray; its right half, for x at least 2, is solid green starting at the vertex (2, 1). The inverse, y = 2 + square root of (x - 1), is blue and starts at (1, 2). The two solid curves mirror each other across the dashed line y = x; (3, 2) on f matches (2, 3) on the inverse.
